# T2 — Demo data, documents & extraction

**Read first:** `CLAUDE.md`, `00_PLAN.md`, `plan/handoffs/T1_handoff.md`.
**Depends on:** T1. **Delivers core item:** 2 (upload and extraction).
**Estimate:** one session.

## Goal
A deterministic fictional Plant X dataset, six predefined demo documents, and a supplier upload flow that extracts fields from them, with confidence and click-to-source highlighting.

## In scope
### A. Seed dataset (`data/seed/`, generated by `scripts/generate-seed.ts`, fixed random seed)
- **Plant X** (fictional), INR, GST. 6 vendors: Vihar Chem Supplies, Konkan Packaging Works, Sahyadri Industrial Gases, Deccan Valve & Fittings, Malabar Lab Instruments, Girnar Logistics. Use clearly fictional GSTIN-style IDs and mark the data "fictional" in README.
- POs (with tax code), goods receipts (with dates and quantities, cumulative per line), contracts with price history, delivery notes, UoM rules (kg/MT, nos/box).
- **~40 historical invoices over the last 60 days** (statuses approved, paid, flagged, blocked, with created/resolved dates and root causes). Required for T5 charts: at least 7 cases of "PO not updated after contract change", spread over several suppliers and ages (0–2, 3–7, 8–14, 15+ days). Include **INV-6120** (Deccan Valve & Fittings, paid) for the duplicate demo.
- The generator must `assert` totals (lines × price + GST = total) so numbers can't drift.
### B. Six live demo documents (`data/demo-docs/`, committed; plus the generator `scripts/generate-docs.ts` using pdfkit)
| File | Supplier | Purpose | Expected verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-7781.pdf | Vihar Chem Supplies | **Golden**: 3 lines, 3 different findings | Flag |
| INV-7782.pdf | Konkan Packaging Works | Clean match, total ≤ ₹1,00,000 | Approve |
| INV-6120R.pdf | Deccan Valve & Fittings | Re-issue of paid INV-6120 with a changed number/date | Block (duplicate) |
| INV-7784.pdf | Sahyadri Industrial Gases | No goods receipt yet | Block (missing receipt) |
| INV-7785.jpg | Malabar Lab Instruments | Scanned image; GST 12% billed vs PO tax code 18% | Flag (tax) |
| INV-7786.pdf | Girnar Logistics | Price differs from both PO and contract | Flag (off-contract) |
**Golden invoice INV-7781 (Vihar), PO 4500001234, exact numbers:**
| Line | Item | PO | GR | Other evidence | Invoice | Finding |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Process additive AX-40 | 1,000 kg @ ₹398.00 | 1,000 kg | Contract C-22 amended 01-Oct to ₹412 | 1,000 kg @ ₹412.00 = ₹4,12,000 | +3.5% vs PO; equals contract → PO not updated (owner Buyer) |
| 2 | Catalyst carrier C-12 | 5,000 kg @ ₹86 | 5,000 kg | UoM 1 MT = 1,000 kg | 5 MT @ ₹86,000 = ₹4,30,000 | UoM only, auto-clear |
| 3 | HDPE drum 200 L | 40 nos @ ₹1,450 | 32 nos (02-Dec) | Delivery note DN-5521: 40 nos | 40 nos = ₹58,000 | GR under-posted (owner Warehouse) |
Subtotal ₹9,00,000 · GST 18% ₹1,62,000 · **Total ₹10,62,000** (routes to Approver L1).
### C. Extraction
- PDF: parse the text layer with pdf.js, keep **text items with page coordinates**. Templates for each vendor layout differ slightly (to be realistic). Extract: vendor name/GSTIN, invoice number/date, PO number, line items (description, qty, unit, unit price, amount), tax rate/amount, totals.
- Per-field **confidence** (rule-based: exact label match = high, positional/fuzzy = medium, missing = low) and **bounding box** for click-to-source.
- JPG: run Tesseract.js (offline, bundled). If its result is unusable, fall back to the stored `INV-7785.extracted.json`, and show a "Fixture result: scanned image" note in the UI. Never hide this.
- Sanity checks: lines sum to subtotal; tax rate × subtotal = tax; totals consistent. Failures lower confidence and are shown.
### D. Supplier upload UI (`/supplier`)
- "Upload invoice" drop zone plus a **"Use a demo document"** dropdown listing the six files (this is the Rule 4 helper). PDF and image accepted.
- After upload: split view with the document and an editable extracted-fields panel; clicking a field highlights its region; confidence chips; low-confidence fields marked "Check". Supplier confirms and submits → invoice created with status "Submitted".
- Supplier list shows their invoices with status chips (status values filled in by later tickets).

## Out of scope
Matching, verdicts, workflow (T3+). Handling arbitrary real-world invoice layouts.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `npm run seed` regenerates identical data (diff-clean on second run); all totals assert.
- [ ] All six documents extract with ≥ 95% of expected fields correct (checked by an automated test against `data/demo-docs/*.expected.json`).
- [ ] Click-to-source highlights the right region for at least vendor, PO number, one line item, tax and total.
- [ ] Upload works for PDF and JPG; wrong file type shows a clear error; a corrupt file doesn't crash the page.
- [ ] Works fully offline; extraction completes in < 5 s per PDF and < 15 s for the JPG (or falls back visibly).
- [ ] Demo documents look like real invoices (vendor letterhead styles differ, realistic fonts, GST block, no "sample" watermark on the body; a small "Fictional demo document" footer is fine).
- [ ] Unit tests: extraction of INV-7781 yields exactly the table above.

## Tester checklist
Upload every demo doc via the dropdown and by drag-and-drop; edit a field; upload a `.txt` and a 0-byte PDF; verify extracted values against the sheet; check highlights; reset and re-run.

## Handoff
`plan/handoffs/T2_handoff.md`: dataset summary, document list with expected values, known extraction limits.
